abstract: Most teratomas involving the thyroid gland are benign and occur in children. However, the adult cases reported are mostly malignant. Many of the cases previously described in the medical literature have fatal outcome because of spread of the tumor refractory to treatment. We report a case of primary malignant teratoma of the thyroid in a 38-year-old pregnant black woman. She was treated with a combination of surgery, and postoperative chemotherapy with good initial response.
abstract_ja: 甲状腺の奇形腫の大半は良性で、小児に生じる。しかし報告された成人例はほとんどが悪性であり、治療抵抗性の進展により致死的な経過をたどった症例が多い。我々は38歳の妊娠中の黒人女性における甲状腺原発悪性奇形腫の症例を報告する。本症例は手術と術後化学療法の併用により治療され、初期治療に良好な反応を示した。
